name: ObjectivesComponentServerFacet_UpdateTrackedObjectives
summary: The client's tracked-objectives update: the shared 16-byte head (two u64 BE) then a prefix-varint count (<= 8) and that many u64 BE tracked-objective ids. 17..81 byte body, C2S. Live channel-0 records match the writer/reader layout field for field.
purpose: Tell the server which objectives the player is tracking. The server changes the objectives replicated state; the Objectives family has no reply for this request.

created_when: the player tracks, untracks, or reorders a tracked objective in the journal
lifecycle.if_absent: the server never learns the tracked-objective set and cannot replay it

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): typed header 00 01 followed by the prefix varint b2 16, i.e. type_dec 1458. A client channel-0 record carries that typed header at offset 24, after the 8-byte frame head and the 16-byte actor id.

fields.name: field_a
fields.note: First of the shared 16-byte head (FUN_1414dbca0, reader FUN_14150e670). Measured 0x180f8d4e573697c6 in the live channel-0 bodies. meanings.md 'The Journal families' row 0x5b2: 'head'.

fields.name: field_b
fields.note: Second head u64. Measured 0xbf85314bbc4a951a (the local-player key the atlas already documents). meanings.md 'The Journal families' row 0x5b2: 'head'.

fields.name: tracked_objective_ids
fields.note: Prefix-varint count (stated <= 8) then count x u64 BE. meanings.md 'The Journal families' row 0x5b2: 'head + varint(len <= 8) + N u64 BE'. Live bodies show count 0 (17-byte body) and count 6 (65-byte body).

evidence.ref: research/atlas/meanings.md 'The Journal families: enumerated wires and the first decoded entry points (2026-10-29)': row 0x5b2 ObjectivesComponentServerFacet_UpdateTrackedObjectives is '17..81 B: head + varint(len <= 8) + N u64 BE', writer FUN_1439f2c00 / reader FUN_1439f2c60; the name is proven by the registration hook (meanings.md '0x5b2 keeps its original name', GUID 298436a9-06d0-4bda-8dd9-0708b36e7374)

local log .azoth/logs/world.log: channel-0 records for wire 0x5b2 carry 17-byte (count 0) and 65-byte (count 6) bodies, both matching the writer/reader order and codec; extracted by scripts/export/export-wire-bodies.py
